title: Standard affine fpqc covers are quotient maps
statement: Let $T=\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{f_j:V_j=\operatorname{Spec}(A_j)\to T\}_{j\in J}$ be a finite family with $R\to\prod_{j\in J}A_j$ faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. For a subset $W\subseteq T$, if every inverse image $f_j^{-1}(W)\subseteq V_j$ is open, then $W$ is open in $T$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 02JY (morphisms-lemma-fpqc-quotient-topology), applied to the coproduct of the finite standard fpqc family

proof.text: Put B = product_j A_j. Faithful flatness supplies Module.Flat R B and surjectivity of PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R B), by PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat. The affine quotient-topology result is applied directly in its prime-spectrum form: RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff and RingHom.Flat.generalizingMap_comap give a generalizing map, and PrimeSpectrum.isQuotientMap_of_generalizingMap gives the quotient map. This is the affine proof of the flat quasi-compact surjective quotient-map theorem; it works without putting the product ring and R into the same universe.

Use the underlying topological form of the finite affine coproduct-spectrum isomorphism, PrimeSpectrum.sigmaToPiHomeo A. It identifies the disjoint union of PrimeSpectrum (A j) with PrimeSpectrum B, and its restriction to the j-th component is comap of Pi.evalRingHom A j. Hence openness of the product-spectrum inverse image can be checked on each component, by the homeomorphism open-preimage criterion and isOpen_sigma_iff.

source.place: Tag 00ED, finite product spectrum decomposition; Mathlib/RingTheory/Spectrum/Prime/Topology.lean, sigmaToPiHomeo

proof.text: For each j, PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp_apply identifies the pullback along the product-spectrum map followed by comap of evaluation with comap (algebraMap R (A j)): the composite ring homomorphism sends r to algebraMap R (A j) r. This is exactly hW j, since the topology and map on Spec are the prime-spectrum topology and comap. Thus the product-spectrum inverse image is open, and the quotient-map open-preimage criterion proves IsOpen W.
